02f0ec8d6c49f9531afc8741349257ece94c1b17.name: index_read_edges
02f0ec8d6c49f9531afc8741349257ece94c1b17.sql:
CREATE VIEW index_read_edges AS
      SELECT r.* FROM moc_edges r LEFT JOIN mocs p ON p.id = r.parent_id WHERE (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id) IS NULL
      UNION ALL SELECT r.* FROM moc_edges r JOIN mocs p ON p.id = r.parent_id JOIN mocs c ON c.id = r.child_id
      JOIN index_edges i ON i.parent_id = r.parent_id AND i.child_id = r.child_id AND i.parent_revision = r.parent_revision AND i.child_revision = r.child_revision AND i.generation = (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id)
      WHERE p.owner_id = c.owner_id AND p.scope = c.scope AND p.project_id = c.project_id AND p.level = 2 AND c.level = 1 AND p.revision = r.parent_revision AND c.revision = r.child_revision

CREATE VIEW index_read_memory_refs AS
      SELECT r.* FROM moc_memory_refs r LEFT JOIN mocs p ON p.id = r.moc_id WHERE (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id) IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memories h WHERE h.id = r.memory_id AND h.currentness = 'historical') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memories h WHERE h.id=r.memory_id AND h.review_state='awaiting')
      UNION ALL SELECT r.* FROM moc_memory_refs r JOIN mocs p ON p.id = r.moc_id JOIN memories c ON c.id = r.memory_id
      JOIN index_memory_refs i ON i.moc_id = r.moc_id AND i.memory_id = r.memory_id AND i.moc_revision = r.moc_revision AND i.memory_revision = r.memory_revision AND i.generation = (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id)
      WHERE p.owner_id = c.owner_id AND p.scope = c.scope AND p.project_id = c.project_id AND p.level = 1 AND c.deleted = 0 AND p.revision = r.moc_revision AND c.revision = r.memory_revision AND c.currentness = 'current' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memories h WHERE h.id=r.memory_id AND h.review_state='awaiting')

CREATE TRIGGER index_memories_update AFTER UPDATE ON memories BEGIN UPDATE index_memories SET id = NEW.id,revision = NEW.revision
      WHERE id = OLD.id AND generation IN
        (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = OLD.owner_id AND s.scope = OLD.scope AND s.project_id = OLD.project_id);
      DELETE FROM index_memories WHERE id = NEW.id
        AND generation IN (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = OLD.owner_id AND s.scope = OLD.scope AND s.project_id = OLD.project_id)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memories r WHERE r.id = NEW.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.currentness = 'current' AND r.review_state != 'awaiting');INSERT OR REPLACE INTO index_memories(generation,id,revision)
      SELECT (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = r.owner_id AND s.scope = r.scope AND s.project_id = r.project_id),r.id,r.revision
      FROM memories r WHERE OLD.review_state = 'awaiting' AND NEW.review_state != 'awaiting' AND r.id = NEW.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.currentness = 'current' AND r.review_state != 'awaiting' AND (SELECT active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s WHERE s.owner_id = r.owner_id AND s.scope = r.scope AND s.project_id = r.project_id) IS NOT NULL; END

361b1d499ee14e1f542ac939e6a11415356fbfa2.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER card_memory_revision_invalidation AFTER UPDATE OF revision ON memories
      WHEN OLD.revision!=NEW.revision AND EXISTS(
        SELECT 1 FROM card_memory_bindings WHERE memory_id=OLD.id)
    BEGIN
      SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT c.id FROM private_cards c JOIN card_memory_bindings b ON b.card_id=c.id
        WHERE b.memory_id=OLD.id AND c.owner_id=OLD.owner_id AND c.scope=OLD.scope
          AND c.project_id=OLD.project_id AND c.state IN ('draft','confirmed') LIMIT 129
      ))>128 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'card_dependency_limit_reached') END;
      INSERT OR IGNORE INTO card_raw_pending_invalidations(card_id,revision)
      SELECT DISTINCT c.id,c.revision FROM card_memory_bindings b INDEXED BY card_memory_dependents
      CROSS JOIN private_cards c ON c.id=b.card_id
      WHERE b.memory_id=OLD.id AND c.owner_id=OLD.owner_id AND c.scope=OLD.scope AND c.project_id=OLD.project_id
        AND c.state IN ('draft','confirmed') AND EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM card_raw_mutation_context x WHERE x.owner_id=c.owner_id AND x.scope=c.scope AND x.project_id=c.project_id)
        AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM card_raw_bindings r WHERE r.card_id=c.id);
      SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM (
        SELECT 1 FROM card_raw_pending_invalidations LIMIT 129
      ))>128 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'card_dependency_limit_reached') END;
      INSERT INTO card_effects
        (effect_id,owner_id,scope,project_id,kind,entity_type,entity_id,revision,action_id,ordinal)
      SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))),c.owner_id,c.scope,c.project_id,
        'evidence_invalidated','card',c.id,c.revision+1,
        'memory-revision-'||OLD.id||'-'||NEW.revision,
        (SELECT coalesce(max(ordinal),0) FROM card_effects)+row_number() OVER(ORDER BY c.id)
      FROM private_cards c WHERE c.owner_id=OLD.owner_id AND c.scope=OLD.scope
        AND c.project_id=OLD.project_id AND c.state IN ('draft','confirmed') AND NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM card_raw_pending_invalidations p WHERE p.card_id=c.id) AND EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM card_memory_bindings b WHERE b.card_id=c.id AND b.memory_id=OLD.id);
      INSERT INTO card_epochs(owner_id,scope,project_id,generation)
      SELECT OLD.owner_id,OLD.scope,OLD.project_id,2
      WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM card_raw_mutation_context x WHERE x.owner_id=OLD.owner_id
        AND x.scope=OLD.scope AND x.project_id=OLD.project_id)
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM card_memory_bindings b INDEXED BY card_memory_dependents
          CROSS JOIN private_cards c ON c.id=b.card_id WHERE b.memory_id=OLD.id AND c.owner_id=OLD.owner_id AND c.scope=OLD.scope
          AND c.project_id=OLD.project_id AND c.state IN ('draft','confirmed') AND NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM card_raw_pending_invalidations p WHERE p.card_id=c.id)
        )
      ON CONFLICT(owner_id,scope,project_id) DO UPDATE SET generation=generation+1;
      UPDATE private_cards SET revision=revision+1,updated_at=NEW.updated_at,
        title=CASE WHEN state='draft' THEN NULL ELSE title END,
        body=CASE WHEN state='draft' THEN NULL ELSE body END,
        state=CASE WHEN state='draft' THEN 'cancelled' ELSE state END
      WHERE owner_id=OLD.owner_id AND scope=OLD.scope AND project_id=OLD.project_id
        AND state IN ('draft','confirmed') AND NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM card_raw_pending_invalidations p WHERE p.card_id=private_cards.id) AND EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM card_memory_bindings b WHERE b.card_id=private_cards.id AND b.memory_id=OLD.id);
      
    END

CREATE TRIGGER index_moc_edges_update AFTER UPDATE ON moc_edges BEGIN UPDATE index_edges SET parent_id = NEW.parent_id,child_id = NEW.child_id,parent_revision = NEW.parent_revision,child_revision = NEW.child_revision
      WHERE parent_id = OLD.parent_id AND child_id = OLD.child_id AND generation IN
        (SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s JOIN mocs p ON s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id
        WHERE p.id = OLD.parent_id
       UNION SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s
        JOIN mocs c ON s.owner_id = c.owner_id AND s.scope = c.scope AND s.project_id = c.project_id
        WHERE c.id = OLD.child_id);
      DELETE FROM index_edges WHERE parent_id = NEW.parent_id AND child_id = NEW.child_id
        AND generation IN (SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s JOIN mocs p ON s.owner_id = p.owner_id AND s.scope = p.scope AND s.project_id = p.project_id
        WHERE p.id = OLD.parent_id
       UNION SELECT s.active_generation FROM namespace_index_state s
        JOIN mocs c ON s.owner_id = c.owner_id AND s.scope = c.scope AND s.project_id = c.project_id
        WHERE c.id = OLD.child_id)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM moc_edges r JOIN mocs p ON p.id = r.parent_id JOIN mocs c ON c.id = r.child_id WHERE r.parent_id = NEW.parent_id AND r.child_id = NEW.child_id AND p.owner_id = c.owner_id AND p.scope = c.scope AND p.project_id = c.project_id AND p.level = 2 AND c.level = 1 AND p.revision = r.parent_revision AND c.revision = r.child_revision); END

ca0c850f37d0ffc455b9635ed02be259958b63d9.name: card_memory_revision_invalidation
ca0c850f37d0ffc455b9635ed02be259958b63d9.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER card_memory_revision_invalidation AFTER UPDATE OF revision ON memories
      WHEN OLD.revision!=NEW.revision AND EXISTS(
        SELECT 1 FROM card_memory_bindings WHERE memory_id=OLD.id)
    BEGIN
      SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT c.id FROM private_cards c JOIN card_memory_bindings b ON b.card_id=c.id
        WHERE b.memory_id=OLD.id AND c.owner_id=OLD.owner_id AND c.scope=OLD.scope
          AND c.project_id=OLD.project_id AND c.state IN ('draft','confirmed') LIMIT 129
      ))>128 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'card_dependency_limit_reached') END;
      INSERT INTO card_effects
        (effect_id,owner_id,scope,project_id,kind,entity_type,entity_id,revision,action_id,ordinal)
      SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))),c.owner_id,c.scope,c.project_id,
        'evidence_invalidated','card',c.id,c.revision+1,
        'memory-revision-'||OLD.id||'-'||NEW.revision,
        (SELECT coalesce(max(ordinal),0) FROM card_effects)+row_number() OVER(ORDER BY c.id)
      FROM private_cards c WHERE c.owner_id=OLD.owner_id AND c.scope=OLD.scope
        AND c.project_id=OLD.project_id AND c.state IN ('draft','confirmed') AND EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM card_memory_bindings b WHERE b.card_id=c.id AND b.memory_id=OLD.id);
      UPDATE private_cards SET revision=revision+1,updated_at=NEW.updated_at,
        title=CASE WHEN state='draft' THEN NULL ELSE title END,
        body=CASE WHEN state='draft' THEN NULL ELSE body END,
        state=CASE WHEN state='draft' THEN 'cancelled' ELSE state END
      WHERE owner_id=OLD.owner_id AND scope=OLD.scope AND project_id=OLD.project_id
        AND state IN ('draft','confirmed') AND EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM card_memory_bindings b WHERE b.card_id=private_cards.id AND b.memory_id=OLD.id);
      INSERT INTO card_epochs(owner_id,scope,project_id,generation)
        VALUES(OLD.owner_id,OLD.scope,OLD.project_id,2)
        ON CONFLICT(owner_id,scope,project_id) DO UPDATE SET generation=generation+1;
    END

CREATE TABLE capture_initial_classification (
    owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('personal','project')),
    project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    client TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('not_started','in_flight_or_interrupted',
      'applied','skipped_already_filed','failed','skipped_empty')),
    bound_refs TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(bound_refs) <= 4096),
    selected_refs TEXT CHECK (selected_refs IS NULL OR length(selected_refs) <= 4096),
    final_refs TEXT CHECK (final_refs IS NULL OR length(final_refs) <= 4096),
    attempt_token TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (owner_id,scope,project_id,client,event_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (owner_id,scope,project_id,client,event_id)
      REFERENCES admission_claims(owner_id,scope,project_id,client,event_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CHECK ((scope = 'personal' AND project_id = '') OR
      (scope = 'project' AND length(project_id) > 0)),
    CHECK ((status = 'not_started' AND selected_refs IS NULL AND final_refs IS NULL
        AND attempt_token IS NULL) OR
      (status = 'skipped_empty' AND selected_refs IS NULL AND final_refs = '[]'
        AND attempt_token IS NULL) OR
      (status = 'in_flight_or_interrupted' AND selected_refs IS NOT NULL
        AND final_refs IS NULL AND attempt_token IS NOT NULL) OR
      (status = 'failed' AND selected_refs IS NOT NULL AND final_refs IS NULL
        AND attempt_token IS NULL) OR
      (status = 'skipped_already_filed' AND selected_refs = '[]'
        AND final_refs IS NOT NULL AND attempt_token IS NULL) OR
      (status = 'applied' AND selected_refs IS NOT NULL
        AND final_refs IS NOT NULL AND attempt_token IS NULL))
  ) STRICT
